sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A perennial carnivorous plant endemic to the Chimantá massif in Bolívar State, Venezuela. It grows on wet tepuis in nutrient-poor conditions.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Its leaves form upright pitcher traps that catch small animals. The species is related to H. glabra, also native to the Guiana Highlands.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is documented; this carnivorous plant is not a food plant.
